fato_historico: 1916: The Kingdom of Poland is proclaimed by the Act of 5th November of the emperors of Germany and Austria-Hungary.
titulo: Find Harmony in Your New Beginnings
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle dawn of sovereignty for your spirit, Libra. Much like the historic proclamation of new borders, consider how you can reclaim your own boundaries. It is a good time to negotiate peace within yourself and plant the seeds of balance that will allow your true intentions to flourish into a beautiful, lasting reality.
frase_do_dia: Build your own kingdom of peace and grace upon the solid ground of truth.
significado_numero: The number of change, freedom, and bold new pathways forward.
conselho: Stand tall in your decisions and honor your need for inner equilibrium today.
